name: Name tag: anchor thread
when: A character is named in a shot with someone else in it: a ring sits on the person and a fine line leads to the name, set bottom-left on a dark, calm part of the frame.
anchor: The scene starts on the character's name: the ring pops 4 frames in, the name lands from frame 19.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.name: the character's name as the voice says it, 18 characters at most
vars.role: one short line about them, 44 characters at most; empty = name only
vars.ringX: where the ring sits on the person (their chest), x in px on the 1920x1080 frame; right of the name block (validated: 1398)
vars.track: optional: the ring follows the person, one point per frame from the scene's start, written "x,y x,y ..." (30 fps; the last point holds). Empty = the ring stays at ringX, ringY
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.33 s later)

changed: The bottom-left dim is a layer of the template (fades in over 12 frames, out with the text) instead of baked into the footage. The ring's position is a value; the validated clip tracked Jason's shirt frame by frame, which the track value reproduces. The tail's end is measured from the name instead of fixed for one name.
